name: create_rust_parallel_map
description: Implements an order-preserving parallel map over scoped threads
prompts: Create src/lib.rs exporting pub fn parallel_map<T, U, F>(items: Vec<T>, workers: usize, f: F) -> Vec<U> where T: Send + Sync, U: Send, F: Fn(&T) -> U + Sync - it applies f to every item using up to `workers` OS threads (std::thread::scope is the clean tool; split the items into contiguous chunks) and returns the results IN INPUT ORDER. It must actually parallelize: `workers` threads working on chunks concurrently, not one thread doing everything. Handle workers > items and empty input.
